review.name: project_bind
review.summary: Resolve the selected project physically and bind every primary runtime path once.

inputs.description: Argument1 is an existing project directory; the caller may pass a relative path. Current working directory supplies relative-path interpretation.

outputs.description: Sets PROJECT, exported RALPHIE_PROJECT, HOME_DIR, STATE_FILE, EVENTS_FILE, GATES_FILE, OBJECTIVE_FILE, ASK_FILE, MEMORY_FILE, LOG_DIR, RUN_DIR, LOCK_FILE and STOP_FILE. No normal stdout.

side_effects.description: Exports the physical project path to child processes. The cd runs in command substitution; the caller working directory is unchanged. No directories are created here.

invariants.description: Every primary runtime path derives from the single physical PROJECT value.

failure_recovery.description: A failed directory resolution invokes die and exits1; it does not fall back to another project.

review.name: terminal_printf
review.summary: Print to stdout and translate a failed pipe write into the SIGPIPE cleanup protocol.

inputs.description: Printf format and arguments, plus /dev/stdout file type.

outputs.description: Formatted stdout; returns printf status, or141 when a failed write targets a pipe.

side_effects.description: On a pipe failure invokes on_pipe, which retires stdout and latches SIGPIPE_SEEN.

invariants.description: Only a failed write together with a pipe-shaped stdout takes the special SIGPIPE path.

failure_recovery.description: Ordinary non-pipe print failures retain their original status.

review.name: say
review.summary: Print one uncolored line through the pipe-aware output helper.

outputs.description: Stdout line and terminal_printf status.

side_effects.description: May trigger the shared broken-pipe protocol.

invariants.description: Formatting is fixed to %s followed by a newline.

failure_recovery.description: Print errors propagate through terminal_printf.

review.name: info
review.summary: Print an informational colored line unless quiet mode is true.

outputs.description: No output with successful status when quiet; otherwise formatted stdout.

side_effects.description: May trigger the shared broken-pipe protocol.

invariants.description: Suppressing a line succeeds because the guard uses OR.

failure_recovery.description: Print errors otherwise propagate through terminal_printf.

review.name: good
review.summary: Print a success-colored line.

inputs.description: Color globals and message arguments; QUIET is not consulted.

outputs.description: Formatted stdout and terminal_printf status.

side_effects.description: May trigger the shared broken-pipe protocol.

invariants.description: Success output remains visible in quiet mode.

failure_recovery.description: Print errors propagate through terminal_printf.

review.name: warn
review.summary: Print a warning-colored line to stderr.

outputs.description: Stderr line and printf status.

side_effects.description: Writes to stderr directly.

invariants.description: No stdout dependency.

failure_recovery.description: No local write-error recovery.

review.name: err
review.summary: Print an error-colored line to stderr.

outputs.description: Stderr line and printf status.

side_effects.description: Writes to stderr directly.

invariants.description: No stdout dependency.

failure_recovery.description: No local write-error recovery.

review.name: dim
review.summary: Print a dim line unless quiet mode is true.

inputs.description: QUIET, color globals and message arguments.

outputs.description: Successful silence when quiet; otherwise formatted stdout.

side_effects.description: May trigger the shared broken-pipe protocol.

invariants.description: Suppressing the message does not cause a false command failure.

failure_recovery.description: Print errors otherwise propagate through terminal_printf.

review.name: dbg
review.summary: Print a debug line to stderr only when verbosity is true.

inputs.description: VERBOSE, color globals and message arguments.

outputs.description: Optional stderr line; returns0.

side_effects.description: Direct stderr write when enabled.

invariants.description: The final OR true makes debug output non-fatal.

failure_recovery.description: Suppression and print failure are both successful to the caller.

review.name: die
review.summary: Report a prefixed fatal message and exit.

outputs.description: Stderr via err, then process exit1.

side_effects.description: Triggers any installed EXIT trap.

invariants.description: The fatal prefix is ralphie:.

failure_recovery.description: No local continuation after exit1.

review.name: now_iso
review.summary: Emit the current UTC timestamp for ledger records.

outputs.description: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ plus newline on stdout.

side_effects.description: Reads the system clock.

invariants.description: UTC formatting is explicit through date -u.

failure_recovery.description: Date failure has no local fallback.

review.name: now_epoch
review.summary: Emit the current epoch second.

outputs.description: Decimal epoch seconds plus newline on stdout.

side_effects.description: Reads the system clock.

invariants.description: Uses date +%s.

failure_recovery.description: Date failure has no local fallback.

review.name: stamp
review.summary: Emit a UTC timestamp suitable for a run identifier.

outputs.description: YYYYMMDDTHHMMSSZ plus newline on stdout.

side_effects.description: Reads the system clock.

invariants.description: UTC formatting omits punctuation unsafe for common filenames.

failure_recovery.description: Date failure has no local fallback.

review.name: have
review.summary: Check whether command resolution can find a name.

inputs.description: Argument1 command name and current shell/PATH command resolution.

outputs.description: Only command -v status; stdout and stderr are discarded.

side_effects.description: No invocation of the named command.

invariants.description: Presence is a resolution check, not a health or authentication probe.

failure_recovery.description: Missing names return nonzero.

review.name: sha_of
review.summary: Hash stdin using the first available supported digest tool.

inputs.description: Stdin bytes and availability of sha256sum, shasum and openssl.

outputs.description: Digest text; fallback is cksum checksum-bytecount.

side_effects.description: Runs one selected external digest implementation.

invariants.description: Selection order is sha256sum, shasum -a256, openssl SHA256, then cksum.

failure_recovery.description: No retry follows a present digest tool failing; fallback choice is based on presence. cksum is explicitly weaker than SHA256.

review.name: timeout_cmd
review.summary: Return the available GNU timeout command name or an empty line.

outputs.description: timeout, gtimeout, or an empty line.

side_effects.description: No timeout command is executed.

invariants.description: timeout is preferred over gtimeout.

failure_recovery.description: No available timeout produces a successful empty result.

review.name: rand_token
review.summary: Generate a small run/lock token.

inputs.description: Readable /dev/urandom, od presence, current time and shell PID.

outputs.description: Twelve hexadecimal characters when urandom is used; otherwise epoch seconds concatenated with PID.

side_effects.description: Reads6 random bytes or the system clock.

invariants.description: The fallback avoids relying on Bash RANDOM alone.

failure_recovery.description: No uniqueness or cryptographic guarantee follows from the fallback; od failure is not retried locally.

review.name: json_escape
review.summary: Escape textual stdin for a JSON string body.

outputs.description: Backslashes, quotes and tabs escaped; CR and other control bytes dropped; input line boundaries represented as literal backslash-n.

side_effects.description: Runs a sed/awk pipeline with C locale for sed.

invariants.description: It emits the string body without surrounding quotes or a trailing newline of its own.

failure_recovery.description: This deliberately is not binary-preserving JSON serialization. Pipeline failures have no local recovery.

review.name: json_str
review.summary: Escape a single argument as a JSON string body.

outputs.description: Escaped text on stdout.

side_effects.description: Pipes the argument to json_escape.

invariants.description: Printf prevents the argument from acting as a format string.

failure_recovery.description: Propagates pipeline failures.

review.name: is_int
review.summary: Recognize a nonempty unsigned decimal digit string.

outputs.description: Status0 for digits only;1 for empty or any other byte.

side_effects.description: None.

invariants.description: Signs, spaces and decimal points are rejected.

failure_recovery.description: Invalid data returns1 without output.

review.name: is_true
review.summary: Recognize common case-insensitive true values.

outputs.description: Status0 for1/true/yes/y/on;1 otherwise.

side_effects.description: Lowercases through tr.

invariants.description: False, empty and unrecognized spellings return1.

failure_recovery.description: No diagnostics for invalid values.

review.name: trim
review.summary: Trim leading and trailing whitespace from an argument.

outputs.description: Trimmed text on stdout.

side_effects.description: Runs sed.

invariants.description: Whitespace processing follows sed line semantics.

failure_recovery.description: No local recovery for a failed text pipeline.

review.name: tail_of
review.summary: Read a bounded tail of an existing regular file.

inputs.description: Argument1 path; optional byte count default4000.

outputs.description: Up to the requested trailing bytes on stdout; returns0.

side_effects.description: Reads the file, suppressing tail stderr.

invariants.description: Missing/nonregular files are a successful empty read.

failure_recovery.description: Tail failure is suppressed by OR true.

review.name: secs_since
review.summary: Compute elapsed seconds from an epoch value.

inputs.description: Optional epoch argument default0 and current system time.

outputs.description: Current epoch minus supplied integer, without newline.

side_effects.description: Reads the system clock.

invariants.description: A non-integer input is normalized to0.

failure_recovery.description: Future epochs can produce negative elapsed time; no clock-skew correction is applied.

review.name: file_bytes
review.summary: Return a regular file byte count or zero.

outputs.description: Unsigned decimal count, normalized to0 when absent, nonregular, failed or invalid.

side_effects.description: Reads file contents through wc -c.

invariants.description: Checks regular-file existence before opening the path.

failure_recovery.description: A failed count is replaced by0; concurrent path changes are not locked.

review.name: count_of
review.summary: Count stdout lines from an arbitrary supplied command.

inputs.description: All arguments form the callback command argv.

outputs.description: Nonnegative integer line count, or0 on pipeline failure/invalid count.

side_effects.description: Executes caller-supplied command; its stderr is suppressed and its stdout is consumed.

invariants.description: A nonzero callback status becomes count0 under inherited pipefail.

failure_recovery.description: No-match grep is normalized without creating a duplicated zero. Callback side effects are not constrained.

review.name: human_secs
review.summary: Format a duration in seconds, minutes or hours.

outputs.description: Ns, NmNs or NhNm without newline.

side_effects.description: None besides stdout.

invariants.description: Invalid integers normalize to0; hours output omits residual seconds.

failure_recovery.description: No handling beyond unsigned-digit validation.

review.name: budget_left
review.summary: Compute remaining time under the absolute run deadline.

outputs.description: -1 for unlimited; otherwise seconds remaining clamped at0.

side_effects.description: Reads the system clock.

invariants.description: Only a positive deadline creates a bounded budget.

failure_recovery.description: The global deadline is trusted numeric input here.

review.name: budget_expired
review.summary: Test whether an active run budget is exhausted.

outputs.description: Status0 exactly when budget_left is the string0.

side_effects.description: None beyond the clock read delegated to budget_left.

invariants.description: Unlimited (-1) does not count as expired.

failure_recovery.description: No local recovery beyond budget_left.

review.name: budget_cap
review.summary: Clamp a requested timeout to the remaining run budget.

outputs.description: Requested limit when unlimited; bounded minimum with a1-second floor otherwise.

side_effects.description: No persistent mutation.

invariants.description: Requested0 means no local limit; an exhausted finite budget still produces1 rather than unlimited0.

failure_recovery.description: Invalid requested integers normalize to0. The return is a timeout value, not a guarantee of exact wall-clock termination.

review.name: state_get
review.summary: Read the last stored value for a key, or a supplied default.

outputs.description: Last matching key=value suffix or default on stdout.

side_effects.description: Reads the state file using grep/tail.

invariants.description: Missing/nonregular state returns the default. Duplicate keys use the last line.

failure_recovery.description: The key is interpolated into a regex and is expected to be an internal key; read failures are suppressed.

review.name: state_set
review.summary: Replace one allowlisted state key using a directory mutex and temporary file.

inputs.description: Key/value arguments, STATE_KEYS, HOME_DIR, STATE_FILE; time/PID/randomness for scratch identity.

outputs.description: Best-effort state update; no success receipt other than file state. Unknown keys and unwritable HOME_DIR return0 after debug text.

side_effects.description: Creates HOME_DIR; may repair STATE_FILE; creates/removes state.lock; rewrites a same-directory temporary file and renames it; failure fallback removes state and writes the single requested key.

invariants.description: Only allowlisted keys are accepted; CR and LF are removed from values. The normal path verifies the rename destination is a regular file.

failure_recovery.description: After30 failed mutex acquisitions the lock is forcibly replaced. Rename/postcondition failure takes a best-effort destructive state fallback; preservation of other keys is not guaranteed by that fallback.

review.name: state_bump
review.summary: Increment a state counter through the common writer.

inputs.description: Key and optional increment default1; state value default0.

outputs.description: Updated state via state_set.

side_effects.description: Mutates one state key.

invariants.description: An invalid existing counter becomes0.

failure_recovery.description: Increment expression is trusted; state_set retains its best-effort semantics.

review.name: event
review.summary: Append one textual JSON event and update the last-write timestamp.

inputs.description: Kind/status/detail arguments and optional key=value extras; CY_N/RUN_ID_MEM globals, state fallback, paths.

outputs.description: One appended events.jsonl record with ts/run/cycle/kind/status/detail and string extras; state updated_at.

side_effects.description: Creates HOME_DIR, repairs a nonregular existing ledger path, appends bytes, then updates state.

invariants.description: In-memory run/cycle identities take precedence over editable state; detail and extra values pass through JSON escaping. Records are appended, not rewritten by this function.

failure_recovery.description: Kind/status/run/extra-key strings are trusted structural inputs rather than escaped values. File write failures have no independent durable queue or fsync.

review.name: ensure_dirs
review.summary: Create the three runtime directories on demand.

outputs.description: Returns0.

side_effects.description: mkdir -p may create project runtime directories.

invariants.description: Repeated calls are allowed.

failure_recovery.description: Creation failures and stderr are suppressed.

review.name: ensure_own_file
review.summary: Repair or report an unusable Ralphie-owned file without rejecting the caller.

inputs.description: Path, human-readable file type, GATES_FILE identity, CMD and UNUSABLE_REPORTED globals.

outputs.description: Returns0; refreshes GATES_FILE_BROKEN for the gate path; may update UNUSABLE_REPORTED.

side_effects.description: May chmod u+r; preserves readable read-only regular-file content; may recursively delete a nonusable existing path and create an empty file; emits console text and potentially one file-unusable event.

invariants.description: Readable protected regular files are not made writable or truncated. Repair success is reported only after replacement succeeds. The broken-file flag is gate-specific.

failure_recovery.description: A path failing -e, including a dangling symlink, returns early. Unrepairable gate paths set GATES_FILE_BROKEN1. Recursive deletion is actual behavior for nonusable existing paths; source comments do not prove their contained data is valueless.

review.name: ensure_state_file
review.summary: Apply common owned-file repair to the state path.

outputs.description: Returns ensure_own_file status, which is designed as0.

side_effects.description: May repair/report the state file.

invariants.description: Uses the shared repair policy.

failure_recovery.description: The wrapper does not reconstruct state counters; rebuild_state_from_ledger is a separate step.

review.name: rebuild_state_from_ledger
review.summary: Reconstruct cycle counters and cycle elapsed time from retained event generations.

inputs.description: EVENTS_FILE and numeric generations; RUN_DIR scratch path; state writer.

outputs.description: Restores max cycle, pass_count, fail_count and positive unverified/blocked/untrusted/learned/time totals; emits a rebuilt event and warning.

side_effects.description: Creates/deletes ledger-all.$$ scratch, rewrites selected state keys, appends one event.

invariants.description: Only cycle timing records contribute seconds; engine timing is excluded. Run-specific token and recovery identity values are not guessed.

failure_recovery.description: Concat failure falls back to the current ledger. No positive cycle causes cleanup/return. Reconstruction is limited to retained textual matching records, not a full JSON replay.

review.name: ledger_init
review.summary: Initialize/repair shared runtime storage without claiming ownership of a run.

outputs.description: Fills missing cycle/pass_count/fail_count/status/started_at defaults; may recover retained counters.

side_effects.description: Creates directories, repairs owned files, writes missing state, may append recovery events. Does not set OWNS_RUN or make pre-dirty snapshots.

invariants.description: Existing nonempty default keys are left unchanged. Rebuild occurs only for empty state with a nonempty current ledger.

failure_recovery.description: This initializer can mutate storage even for commands described as read-only in comments. Discover/help/version bypass it in main; general status does not. Repair/write helpers keep their own failure behavior.

review.name: run_init
review.summary: Start run-owned bookkeeping and remove stale per-PID scratch files.

inputs.description: RUN_DIR; timestamp/random token; caller-held run lock is an ordering precondition.

outputs.description: Sets RUN_ID_MEM and OWNS_RUN1; writes run_id, run_tokens0 and run_cost0.

side_effects.description: Deletes matching stale pre-dirty/staged/index/committed/commit-error artifacts; writes state.

invariants.description: Ownership is enabled only after run identity and usage reset are attempted. No snapshot is made here.

failure_recovery.description: Scratch deletion is best effort. Lock ownership is not checked inside this function; run_prepare supplies that ordering.

review.name: ensure_ignored
review.summary: Exclude Ralphie runtime storage using local Git exclusion metadata.

inputs.description: PROJECT, HOME_DIR/state, Git repository discovery and .git/info/exclude.

outputs.description: No machine stdout; optional debug message.

side_effects.description: May create Git info directory and append a comment plus .ralphie/ exclusion.

invariants.description: Does not edit the tracked .gitignore. An existing effective ignore rule avoids a duplicate append.

failure_recovery.description: No repository, failed metadata resolution/directory creation, or append failure is tolerated without aborting the caller.

review.name: prune_artifacts
review.summary: Prune old numbered cycle artifacts and then consider ledger rotation.

inputs.description: State cycle, RALPHIE_KEEP_CYCLES default50, LOG_DIR and RUN_DIR.

outputs.description: No normal stdout; delegates rotation result.

side_effects.description: Deletes old cycle log/answer/prompt and associated before/after gate captures.

invariants.description: Walks backward from cycle-minus-keep and stops at the first cycle missing all three primary artifacts.

failure_recovery.description: Invalid keep becomes50. Deletion errors are suppressed; gaps can stop pruning older leftovers.

review.name: rotate_ledger
review.summary: Rotate an oversized current ledger into bounded numbered generations.

inputs.description: EVENTS_FILE size, RALPHIE_LEDGER_MAX default16777216, RALPHIE_LEDGER_GENERATIONS default5.

outputs.description: Optional appended ledger-rotated event in a new current file; returns0 on normal/early paths.

side_effects.description: Renames .n-1 to .n from high to low, then current to.1. The highest retained generation may be overwritten.

invariants.description: Current records are moved as a file rather than rewritten record by record. keep and loop index are initialized separately to avoid Bash dynamic-scope declaration leakage.

failure_recovery.description: Failure moving the current ledger returns0. Rotation is finite retention rather than perpetual history. Retention environment values are not validated locally.

review.name: prune_sessions
review.summary: Delete oldest lexical session-directory entries beyond retention.

outputs.description: No normal stdout.

side_effects.description: Lists/sorts entries and recursively removes the first count-minus-keep names.

invariants.description: No session directory or no excess entries is an early return. Invalid keep becomes5.

failure_recovery.description: Deletion failures are suppressed. The line-based listing assumes generated session names, not arbitrary newline-containing paths.

review.name: mark_tree
review.summary: Touch the work-change timestamp marker.

outputs.description: Returns0.

side_effects.description: Creates RUN_DIR and truncates/creates tree.mark.

invariants.description: Marker path is owned runtime storage.

failure_recovery.description: Both mkdir and marker-write failure are suppressed.

review.name: tree_listing_digest
review.summary: Digest the sorted set of non-noise regular-file pathnames.

outputs.description: Hash text from the pathname listing.

side_effects.description: Walks the project filesystem; no file contents are hashed.

invariants.description: Every name in NOISE_DIRS is pruned by find; remaining regular-file pathnames are listed. The name predicate applies to any matching entry, not just directories.

failure_recovery.description: Failed cd produces an empty listing; find errors are suppressed. Newline-delimited names and the weak digest fallback limit this to a change heuristic.

review.name: mark_verify
review.summary: Record the current verification marker and file-set digest.

inputs.description: RUN_DIR and project filesystem through tree_listing_digest.

outputs.description: Sets LAST_VERIFY_LISTING.

side_effects.description: Creates/truncates verify.mark; creates RUN_DIR.

invariants.description: Both timestamp and pathname-set evidence are captured.

failure_recovery.description: Marker creation failure is suppressed; later missing-marker checks make the cache stale.

review.name: verify_mark_stale
review.summary: Tell callers whether filesystem evidence invalidates a cached verdict.

inputs.description: RUN_DIR/verify.mark, LAST_VERIFY_LISTING, current non-noise regular files.

outputs.description: Status0 for missing marker, a newer file, or changed pathname digest; nonzero otherwise.

side_effects.description: Filesystem reads only.

invariants.description: Deletion is observable through the listing digest even when find -newer cannot report it.

failure_recovery.description: This is timestamp/name-set evidence, not exhaustive content freshness or a concurrency barrier.

review.name: find_changed_since
review.summary: List regular project files newer than a supplied marker.

outputs.description: Newline-delimited find paths relative to project root.

side_effects.description: Filesystem metadata reads only.

invariants.description: Captures marker before replacing positional arguments with the find predicate. Every matching NOISE_DIRS name is pruned before regular-file testing.

failure_recovery.description: Failed cd exits the subshell successfully with no output; find errors are hidden.

review.name: tree_touched
review.summary: Check the work-change marker for any newer non-noise regular file.

outputs.description: Status0 if marker missing or a newer path exists;1 otherwise.

side_effects.description: Filesystem reads only.

invariants.description: Absence of the marker is treated as changed.

failure_recovery.description: Deletions alone are not detected by this function. Timestamp granularity remains a filesystem property.

review.name: work_changed
review.summary: Combine the Git/runtime fingerprint with filesystem modification evidence.

inputs.description: Before-fingerprint argument, current PROJECT/runtime state and tree.mark.

outputs.description: Status0 when fingerprint differs or tree_touched succeeds.

side_effects.description: Filesystem/Git reads through helpers.

invariants.description: Either signal is sufficient to report change.

failure_recovery.description: The check inherits the coverage limits of fingerprint and tree_touched; it is not a content snapshot.

review.name: fingerprint
review.summary: Digest Git-visible state together with gate and objective bytes.

outputs.description: Digest of HEAD/status/diff/gates/objective concatenated output.

side_effects.description: Runs Git reads and reads two runtime files.

invariants.description: Tracked content differences are included through git diff HEAD, not only status letters.

failure_recovery.description: Git/read errors are tolerated. It does not hash all untracked/ignored content; it must be combined with timestamp/listing signals for cache decisions.

review.name: lock_acquire
review.summary: Acquire the per-project run lock and reject an apparently live owner.

inputs.description: HOME_DIR, LOCK_FILE, process PID/time, existing pid/token/since files, process table.

outputs.description: LOCK_HELD1 on success; explicit1 on unwritable storage, live owner, acquisition failure or token race loss.

side_effects.description: Creates lock directory/metadata, waits for a possibly starting owner, may recursively remove stale lock, writes a fresh token.

invariants.description: Fresh acquisition uses atomic mkdir; stale takeover waits and compares a surviving random token. kill0 and ps both count as liveness evidence.

failure_recovery.description: No lock capability is provided by the OS beyond mkdir. PID reuse, filesystem concurrency and stale-takeover races are not ruled out by static reading.

review.name: lock_release
review.summary: Release the lock when this process records ownership.

outputs.description: Sets LOCK_HELD0 and returns0.

side_effects.description: Recursively removes LOCK_FILE when the flag is1.

invariants.description: The in-memory flag gates removal.

failure_recovery.description: Removal errors are suppressed; release does not recheck the stored token.

review.name: track_pid
review.summary: Add a child PID to the in-memory cleanup list.

outputs.description: Updated space-delimited CHILD_PIDS.

side_effects.description: In-memory mutation only.

invariants.description: PIDs are retained for later cleanup.

failure_recovery.description: No validation or deduplication of supplied PID.

review.name: untrack_pid
review.summary: Remove a child PID from the cleanup list.

outputs.description: Updated space-delimited CHILD_PIDS.

side_effects.description: Runs text filters and updates memory.

invariants.description: Exact whole-line matching removes the PID after space splitting.

failure_recovery.description: An empty resulting list remains representable. The function returns its text pipeline status; PID input is expected to be internal numeric text.

review.name: child_pids_of
review.summary: Find direct children of a PID using available process tools.

inputs.description: Parent PID and pgrep availability/process table.

outputs.description: Child PIDs, one per line.

side_effects.description: Process-table reads.

invariants.description: pgrep -P is preferred; ps/awk is the fallback.

failure_recovery.description: Process-read errors yield no children through OR true. A changing process tree is not frozen.

review.name: kill_tree
review.summary: Recursively signal a process and its currently visible descendants.

outputs.description: Returns successful best-effort cleanup.

side_effects.description: Signals descendants before the supplied PID.

invariants.description: Child discovery precedes signalling the parent at each recursive level.

failure_recovery.description: Signal failures are suppressed; detached/reparented children may escape this traversal.

review.name: terminate_tree
review.summary: Snapshot descendants, send TERM, then send KILL after a grace period.

outputs.description: No normal stdout.

side_effects.description: Builds a PID list; signals process group and each captured PID with TERM, sleeps2, then KILLs group/list.

invariants.description: Descendants are enumerated before the root is terminated so immediate reparenting does not erase already found children.

failure_recovery.description: Kill errors are ignored. It does not wait/reap the process, freeze PID identity, or discover descendants created after the snapshot.

review.name: reap_children
review.summary: Terminate tracked children that still appear live.

outputs.description: Clears CHILD_PIDS.

side_effects.description: Runs terminate_tree for each PID passing kill0.

invariants.description: Cleanup walks the recorded list, then resets it.

failure_recovery.description: No wait is performed here. Processes failing kill0 are skipped.

review.name: on_exit
review.summary: Perform EXIT cleanup while preserving run/error bookkeeping and SIGPIPE status.

inputs.description: Original shell status, SIGPIPE_SEEN, OWNS_RUN, INTERRUPTED and state status.

outputs.description: May set state status error and append an exit event; explicit exit141 when SIGPIPE was seen.

side_effects.description: Records owned dirty paths if this is a run, reaps children, releases lock, may write state/events.

invariants.description: Non-run commands do not claim run ownership or rewrite run status. SIGPIPE overrides the observed code to141.

failure_recovery.description: Bookkeeping is best effort. EXIT traps do not run on SIGKILL or machine failure; this code is not a power-loss durability proof.

review.name: on_int
review.summary: Stop an interrupted run and exit with conventional interrupt status.

inputs.description: INT/TERM/HUP trap delivery, OWNS_RUN and tracked process state.

outputs.description: Sets INTERRUPTED1; owned run status stopped and interrupted event; exits130.

side_effects.description: Writes console/ledger/state, records owned work, reaps children and releases lock.

invariants.description: The human channel is not read; interruption uses automated cleanup.

failure_recovery.description: Best-effort cleanup precedes exit130 for all three registered signals, not signal-specific143/129.

review.name: on_pipe
review.summary: Retire a broken stdout pipe without exiting inside the signal trap.

outputs.description: Sets SIGPIPE_SEEN1; redirects future stdout to /dev/null.

side_effects.description: Changes file descriptor1 for the current shell.
